design: Freeze H568 means. Pair parentheses and commas around identical words at identical token lengths. Binding templates retained; copying continuation uses and then spoke/wrote to so comma forms remain grammatical. Same evaluation names; no refitting. Predict from pooled discovery phrases by task and length or task alone; cross-task length-matched controls. No refitting or phrase-specific donor available. Insert text strictly after selected name. Fixed heads, no case selection. Compute rotary-only predictions from base prompts before evaluating edited prompts.
scope: Physical edits change query context as well as distance. No claim of pure position manipulation. Coefficient interventions touch only the selected persistent-bus edge; other prompt-induced changes remain.
